description:
## 1.8.0-dev.6 (2026-11-26)

- **BoldVoice:** Add a new `Disable upgrade nudges` patch (enabled by default for 5.1.3 build 470 and 5.3.6 build 499, ARM64 APKS) that bypasses the `RootContainer` force-update gate so supported 5.1.3 installs keep working without the forced-update lockout screen. PairIP full devirtualization for 5.3.6 remains on hold pending ARM64 runtime extraction.
